title: From A to Z!
overview: Bonnie makes a new friend, Ash runs into an old friend, and a terrifying premonition begins to unfold!

title: Love Strikes! Eevee, Yikes!
overview: While Eevee deals with some unwanted attention, Team Rocket turns its attention to Squishy!

title: A Giga Battle with Mega Results!
overview: There's trouble at the local Pokémon Center, but our heroes and Professor Sycamore are there to help!

title: A Fiery Rite of Passage!
overview: As our heroes continue their journey to Snowbelle City, they encounter a young Pokémon faced with the challenges of growing up!

title: Dream a Little Dream from Me!
overview: A nighttime campout brings some interesting adventures for our heroes' Pokémon!

title: The Legend of the Ninja Hero!
overview: Our heroes' friend Sanpei is showing them Ninja Village, his home, but its peace and tranquility is soon to be threatened!

title: A Festival of Decisions!
overview: On the eve of the village festival, the fate of Ninja Village hangs in the balance!

title: A Dancing Debut!
overview: Our heroes are in Couriway Town for Serena's next Pokémon Showcase, and her third Princess Key win is at stake!

title: Meeting at Terminus Cave!
overview: Our heroes are visiting Terminus Cave with hopes of seeing new Pokémon, but they're not alone!

title: A Cellular Connection!
overview: A courageous rescue during our heroes' search for Squishy leaves one of their friends in danger!

title: A Windswept Encounter!
overview: An expansive field of flowers provides our heroes with a beautiful setting to witness a blooming friendship!

title: Party Dancecapades!
overview: Serena is invited to a dance party for Pokémon performers, and there are many surprises in store!

title: A Meeting of Two Journeys!
overview: A fierce battle between two powerful Pokémon is about much more than just who wins!

title: An Explosive Operation!
overview: As Team Flare continues to advance Operation Z, they get help from an unexpected source!

title: A Watershed Moment!
overview: Traversing a vast expanse of parched land, our heroes discover a small group of dedicated individuals in need!

title: Master Class Choices!
overview: It's Pokémon Showcase time for Serena, and winning her third Princess Key is on the line!

title: An Electrifying Rage!
overview: Our heroes are about to take part in an exciting celebration, but the guest of honor is not happy!

title: Unlocking Some Respect!
overview: Our heroes plan to visit a gem exhibition - but they run into a mystery instead!

title: Master Class is in Session!
overview: The Pokémon Showcase Master Class is under way and Serena is competing with friends and rivals galore!

title: Performing a Pathway to the Future!
overview: The Pokémon Showcase Master Class is in full swing and Serena's quest to become Kalos Queen is shifting into high gear!

title: A Keeper for Keeps?
overview: Bonnie has been looking for someone to take care of her big brother, but what will happen when she finds that someone?

title: Battling at Full Volume!
overview: While Ash battles a fever, another Trainer comes along to challenge him to a Pokémon battle!

title: The Synchronicity Test!
overview: Ash and Greninja have displayed some amazing and mysterious traits in battle, and Clemont wants to find out why!

title: Making Friends and Influencing Villains!
overview: Team Rocket is still after Pikachu, but a shy, rare Pokémon is getting in their way!

title: Championing a Research Battle!
overview: Ash wants to learn more about what happens when he and Greninja merge during battle, and the Champion Diantha is the right person to help!

title: A Full-Strength Battle Surprise!
overview: During our heroes' final leg of their journey to Snowbelle City, a chance meeting with an old friend and rival gives Ash a surprising battle opportunity!

title: All Hail the Ice Battlefield!
overview: The time for Ash's Snowbelle City Gym battle is here, and his eighth Gym badge hangs in the balance!

title: Seeing the Forest for the Trees!
overview: Following Ash's defeat at the Snowbelle Gym, some not-so-quiet introspection turns into some real inspiration!

title: A Real Icebreaker!
overview: Ash is back at the Snowbelle City Gym for a rematch, but will Gym Leader Wulfric feel the heat?

title: A Diamond in the Rough!
overview: A visit to the home of friends confronts our heroes with a most unusual group of challenges!

title: A Gaggle of Gadget Greatness!
overview: Clemont has invited the rest of our heroes to experience one of his true passions, while a certain group of uninvited guests are along for the ride!

title: A League of His Own!
overview: The Kalos League is just getting underway, and the battle temperature is already turned way up!

title: Valuable Experience for All!
overview: The Kalos League rages on toward the semifinals, and the red-hot battling never ceases to excite and amaze!

title: Analysis Versus Passion!
overview: The semifinals of the Kalos League have arrived, bringing two intense battles!

title: A Riveting Rivalry!
overview: As the Kalos League semifinal round continues between Ash and Sawyer, the audience witnesses a rivalry few have ever experienced!

title: Kalos League Passion with a Certain Flare!
overview: The final round of the Kalos League is about to get underway, and there's a lot going on behind the scenes!

title: Finals Not for the Faint-Hearted!
overview: It's time for the Kalos League finals and it's Ash versus Alain in their much anticipated battle!

title: Down to the Fiery Finish!
overview: The final round of the Kalos League is in high gear and surprises are in abundance; from the first second to the very last!

title: A Towering Takeover!
overview: Lysandre and Team Flare are attempting to take over Lumiose City and the world and our heroes are in the middle of the chaos!

title: Coming Apart at the Dreams!
overview: Lumiose City is on the verge of ruin, but our heroes and their friends are not about to stand by and do nothing!

title: The Right Hero for the Right Job!
overview: The fate of Kalos and the world depends on the outcome of Team Flare's plans, and our heroes are doing their best to stop them!

title: Rocking Kalos Defenses!
overview: The fate of Chespie and the world rests in the hands of an extraordinarily powerful group of friends and allies!

title: Forming a More Perfect Union!
overview: The moment of truth has arrived, as our heroes and their friends must face the final challenge that will decide the fate of the world!

title: Battling with a Clean Slate!
overview: The Lumiose City Gym is still being repaired, but a battle challenge from a young Trainer is just the thing to get everyone and everything up and running!

title: The First Day of the Rest of Your Life!
overview: Our heroes are busy planning their futures, but one is having more trouble planning than the others!

title: Facing the Needs of the Many!
overview: As our heroes prepare to go their separate ways, they face the return of a danger that wasn't quite defeated!

title: Till We Compete Again!
overview: Our heroes are going their separate ways, and it's time for goodbyes, fond memories, and eyes to the future!

title: The Legend of X, Y, and Z!
overview: A trip to some newly discovered ruins in Kalos reveals a rich history of compassion and caring from three Legendary Pokémon!

title: The Strongest Duo! Citron and Dent!!
overview: Citron visits Kalos to sight-see and enters a fishing competition. Dent uses a fishing machine. Citron calls it deplorable and dismisses him as ignorant. Although unimpressed with his company, Citron agrees to being shown around Lumiose.
